name: Forgent Power Solutions, Inc.

profile.end_markets: FY2026 revenue: Data Center ~59%, Grid ~21%, Industrial ~10%, other ~10%; substantially all revenue from customers in North America (FY2026 10-K). One customer >10% of FY2026 revenue.
profile.products: Engineered-to-order electrical distribution equipment: automatic transfer switches, dry-type transformers, liquid-filled transformers, eHouses, generator connection cabinets, panelboards, PDUs, power skids, remote power panels, switchboards, switchgear, tap boxes; FY2026 revenue ~70% Custom Products, 25% Powertrain Solutions (integrated/skidded systems), 3% Standard Products, 2% services (FY2026 10-K Item 1). Brands/predecessors combined via MGM Transformer (acq. 2023-10-31), PwrQ (2024-03-13), States Manufacturing (2024-05-31), VanTran (TriMagna Industries, 2024-06-14). Vertically integrated transformer manufacturing is a stated strategy.
